Kepivance (palifermin) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-136964  
Guideline Name 
Kepivance (palifermin)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
12/1/2023  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Kepivance  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting all of the following:  
 
 1.1 Medication will be used to prevent or treat severe (WHO Grade 3 or higher) oral 
mucositis  


=== PDF PAGE 1014 ===
Page 1014 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Inadequate response to an oral mouthwash formulated with diphenhydramine/antacid 
and lidocaine (e.g., magic or miracle mouthwash)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by a hematologist or oncologist
